title: In Memory
direction: Use medium-weight impacts and shifting cluster sizes. Let transitions change both density and spatial focus so the surface seems to remember earlier disturbances.

sections.name: memory: opening
sections.note: Return to earlier spatial regions while changing density and group size. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
